proupdater.screen.title: PRO-Updater
proupdater.screen.applyPack.tooltip: Replaces every settings file with the pack's and runs the default steps on the next start, like a fresh install. The files it replaces are backed up first.
proupdater.screen.queue: Queued: %s. Applies after a game restart.
proupdater.backups.title: Restore a backup
proupdater.backups.hint: Made by you or before a run that overwrote settings. Restored on the next start.
proupdater.step.skyblocker_loadout.descr: Switches loadouts with keys in the Loadouts window through Skyblocker (also the hotbar keys in Armor Sets and Equipment Sets), and binds a key that opens Loadouts (/ld, through NoFrills). The same keys in IQ Addons, SkyHanni, Odin, NoFrills and Firmament are turned off so only one mod reacts.
proupdater.step.nofrills_command_keybind: NoFrills custom keybinds that run /eq, /wd and /trades. Your other binds stay as they are; these work outside of menus only.
proupdater.step.nofrills_clear_slot_bind: Removes every NoFrills slot binding (hotbar slot to inventory slot). The feature and its key stay. Never runs on its own after an update.
proupdater.step.resource_packs.descripti: Turns on the pack's resource packs in the right order before the game starts. Resource packs you turned on yourself stay on, above them.
proupdater.step.attack_hold.description: Sets Attack/Destroy back to Hold instead of Toggle. Nothing else changes.
proupdater.notice.newSteps: The pack update brought new setup steps. Open /proupdater to apply them.
proupdater.notice.packApplied: Pack settings %s applied. The old files are in proupdater/backups.
proupdater.notice.restoreFailed: Backup %s could not be read, nothing was restored.
proupdater.notice.resourcePackMissing: Resource pack %s is missing from the resourcepacks folder, so it was not turned on. Reinstall the pack or download it again.
proupdater.notice.configMissing: %s was not found, that setup step was skipped.
proupdater.notice.failed: Could not set up the pack settings, the details are in the log. Send it to soldey on Discord.
proupdater.screen.setup.tooltip: Loadout keys, command keys, slot bindings, resource packs and the attack mode, one step at a time.
proupdater.setup.title: Setup
proupdater.setup.hint: Ticked steps are applied after a game restart.
proupdater.screen.makeBackup.tooltip: Saves the settings files PRO-Updater looks after (options.txt, the pack's configs and every file a step changes) right now.
proupdater.screen.makeBackup.nothing: No settings files to save yet
proupdater.screen.makeBackup.failed: Could not save the backup, the details are in the log
proupdater.screen.queueSteps.tooltip: Queues the ticked steps for the next game start. Unticked steps are taken out of the queue.
